title: Megurine Luka — Greetings Are Idol 101〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: This Way! That Way! Zookeeper Day

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Phew... We did so much today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's already getting fairly late.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thank you both for agreeing to take the others along on your zoo visit.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
We got to see so many animals!
The guinea pigs and rabbits were so cute.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They even had a lot of big animals.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I definitely wasn't expecting to see any alpacas there. They're so much taller than I realized.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The frogs were also really cute!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you all had such a wonderful time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We also sorta lost track of time because we were having so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Like when you got to feed the chipmunks!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Speaking of feedings, getting to see that serval cat tearing into that meat was quite an experience.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, that was pretty incredible...
A good reminder that they're still carnivores.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Airi, Shizuku, which animals did you like seeing?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You can probably guess that I loved seeing all the cats!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Including the Tsushima leopard cats and Pallas's cats, yes?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm so glad Minori and the others recommended seeing them since they were all so adorably fluffy!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The way the Tsushima leopard kittens went wherever their mother went was so cute and heartwarming.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's too bad that there was a pane of glass between us and them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Actually, I'm kinda glad they had that since I probably would've had a sneezing fit if I got too close.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But seeing them was still just as wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. At the same time, I'm starting to feel exhausted after walking around all day.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That makes sense since you two were pretty active today, while all we did was watch...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now I feel kind of bad.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't. We had just as much fun as you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Plus, things went really smoothly because we had Luka acting as our guide.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She's right. You really knew your way around the place.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I did get to see everything from Minori's pocket the whole time she and the others were going around the zoo.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In return for sneaking out that time, I wanted to be a good guide and make sure you all enjoyed yourselves♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, Luka, I doubt we would've been able to see so much if we didn't have you guiding us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I have to be honest, I almost got lost today, but Luka swooped in to show me the way.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
When did this happen?!
She really had to lead you back...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Airi, Shizuku, thank you both again for inviting us to go with you to the zoo today.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It was super duper fun!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why are you being so serious all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Because we talked things over yesterday and decided to do something as a token of our appreciation.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What did you decide to do?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Luka suggested that we put on a mini concert for you two.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We only have a few songs ready, but we hope you'll listen♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, you went to that much effort for us...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'll be more than happy to listen!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then, sit here. It's the VIP section. We promise to give you an incredible performance♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, we're at the very front. We couldn't ask for better seats.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Okay, I think we're all set.
Let's get this mini concert started♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We went with a zoo theme. The songs we chose have to do with animals and the wild. We hope you enjoy.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Start the music!
